target_module: origins/server/inventory.ts (new; path not confirmed against the Frankendom repo)

data_fields.name: item_max_count_per_stack
data_fields.donor_constant: per template (MaxCount); no fixed number in this donor

data_fields.name: move_requested_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 = whole stack; merge should move min(requested, source count, room) (donor moves the whole source count, defect)

data_fields.name: ui_flush_per_batch
data_fields.donor_constant: one flush per outermost batch, only when slots changed

best_idea: Add a loot bundle or purchase all-or-nothing by planning the whole stack placement first (top up existing stacks, then open empty slots) and only then writing, so a full bag refuses the whole bundle.
decision_why: Take the plan-then-commit add and the check-then-apply remove; reject the per-slot rule table and inline DB writes. Frankendom needs all-or-nothing loot awards and one UI flush per award under the one-ledger ruling; the donor's slot switch and inline saves do not fit zones-as-data. Stack caps belong to the item catalogue (rows 20-21), not zones.
acceptance: A server test awards a 20-count loot bundle into a bag with room for 19 and asserts the bag is unchanged and the award returns false; a second test moves 5 of a 20-stack onto a stack of 10 (max 20) and asserts 5 moved, 15 left in the source, and one inventory update sent.
